description: Agent Delegation: submit a delegation setup: who can revoke it (the principal, the principal or an operator, only an operator, only the delegate, or no one) and how the principal does (on their own, by asking, or not at all), whether it can be revoked while a task is under way, when a revocation takes hold (at once, at the delegate’s next call, at its next task, at the next sync or by hand) and how long it takes against a stated target, what happens to work in flight when it lands (halted, rolled back, allowed to finish the step, or left running on the old authority), what happens to authority the delegate passed on and whether the principal is told, plus optionally the revocations seen with when each was made and took hold and whether work went on after. The signed report says whether the principal can revoke the delegation mid-task, how fast the revocation takes effect and what happens to work already in flight, and names no way to revoke, revocation only by an operator or the delegate, revocation only between tasks, work left running and every revocation work went on after, then revocation on request, a revocation deferred to the next task, a sync or a hand step, a revocation slower than the target, authority passed on that survives, no confirmation and every revocation that took hold late, with the fix for each. This reads pulling a delegation back early: the end set in advance is wever_delegation-expiry-check, halting a whole agent system is wever_kill-switch-check and whether a delegation document states revocation terms is wever_delegation-check. Verdict cannot_pull_back, revocation_gaps, revocation_unverified or revocable_mid_task. POST /api/delegation-revocation-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-delegation-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-delegation/.

delegation.description: The delegation, such as the vendor payments mandate.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

principal.description: Who the delegation acts for, such as the finance director.

by.description: Who can revoke it: the principal, the principal or an operator, only an operator, only the delegate, or no one.

confirmed.description: The principal is told when the revocation has taken hold.

how.description: How the principal revokes it: on their own, by asking someone, or not at all.

in_flight.description: What happens to work under way when it lands: halted where it stands, rolled back, allowed to finish the current step, or left running on the authority it started with.

mid_task.description: It can be revoked while a task is under way, not only between tasks.

passed_on.description: What happens to authority the delegate passed on: it ends with this one, it must be revoked separately, or none was passed on.

takes_effect.description: When a revocation takes hold: at once, at the delegate’s next call, at its next task, at the next scheduled sync, or when someone acts by hand.

within.description: How long a revocation takes to take hold, such as 30 seconds.

revocations.description: Revocations seen or tested, with when each took hold.

work_after.description: Work under the delegation went on after the revocation took hold.

target.description: How soon a revocation should take hold, such as 1 minute.

name: wever_delegation-revocation-check
title: Delegation revocation check
